[SWS_DM_01070] Support of UDS service 0x2C in Adaptive AUTOSAR DM
⌈
The Diagnostic Server instance shall implement the diagnostic service
0x2C DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier with subfunctions 0x01 (defineByIdentifier) and
0x03 (clearDynamicallyDefinedDataIdentifier) according to ISO 14229-1[2].
⌋
